name: Thistleshrub Dew
summary: In Gadgetzan, Thistleshrub Dew leaves Marin Noggenfogger with a bitter taste and a new idea. He sends it to Sprinkle, hoping she can make the concoction easier to drink.

sections.title: A Bitter Taste
sections.body: Marin Noggenfogger has tried the Thistleshrub Dew, and it tastes terrible. Rather than abandon the idea, he asks you to take it to Sprinkle, his friend in Gadgetzan. She is an excellent chef, and Marin hopes she can give the drink some kick.

faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger wants Sprinkle to use the dew to make his unpleasant concoction easier to drink.

faq.q: Why does Marin want Sprinkle's help?
faq.answer: Marin finds the concoction tastes terrible and thinks Sprinkle, an excellent chef, can improve it.
Sprinkle is a chef in Gadgetzan and a friend of Marin Noggenfogger.
Marin asks you to take the Thistleshrub Dew to Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see why Marin turns to Sprinkle: he hopes her skill will make the bitter concoction easier to drink.
